Lull: sunlight on your wall, as a live Mac wallpaper
====================================================

Requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or newer, on Apple Silicon or Intel.

1. Drag Lull into the Applications folder (the shortcut is right here in this window).

2. Open Lull from Applications. Because Lull isn't from the App Store or a registered
   Apple developer, macOS blocks it the first time with "Apple could not verify Lull...".
   That's expected. Click Done (not Move to Trash), then:

   macOS 15 Sequoia and newer:
     - Open System Settings > Privacy & Security.
     - Scroll down to Security. You'll see "Lull was blocked to protect your Mac."
     - Click Open Anyway, confirm with your password or Touch ID, then click Open.

   macOS 13 Ventura / 14 Sonoma:
     - Right-click (or Control-click) Lull in Applications, choose Open, then Open again.

   You only have to do this once.

   (Comfortable with Terminal? This does the same thing in one step:
      xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Lull.app )

3. Allow location access when asked, so the light matches the real sun where you are.
   If you skip it, Lull estimates your location from your time zone.

Lull lives in the menu bar (the two slanted bars). From there you can pick the window,
decoration and wall, turn the gentle breeze on or off, preview a whole day, show the
time, and turn on Launch at Login.

To uninstall: choose Quit Lull from its menu, then drag Lull from Applications to the Trash.
